name: Kobayashi Koma
source: Often spotted alongside Yanagi Kyougoku taking photographs of students and then selling them for profit, she is identifiable for wearing a large number of small decorative accessories. She speaks Kansai-ben for no apparent reason. She has a younger brother and two younger sisters.
